verdict.rationale: Docs show billable metrics with flexible aggregation/custom SQL (docs-23), rate cards with subscription pricing (docs-29), commitments/credits/overage support explicitly for prepaid/postpaid commitments and credit batches (docs-13, docs-14), contract-based enterprise deals with overrides/discounts (docs-26, docs-27), and seat/subscription lifecycle management (docs-6, docs-7, docs-31) — all configurable without custom code via UI/API. Missing for 10: explicit named support for 'tiered/volume/graduated/per-unit' terminology and independent hands-on evidence of complex hybrid pricing configuration without code.
